item.title: Melatonin 0.1.9
item.description:
Melatonin 0.1.9

  • T3 Code counts as working while it waits on the model. When T3 Code runs Claude Code, the work Claude writes down now counts for T3 Code, so auto mode keeps your Mac awake through slow model replies, and the menu shows T3 Code instead of Claude Code.
  • Claude Code on another account is seen too. Sessions T3 Code starts with a different Claude config folder are now read where they are.
